recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current core specification already conveys the requested Organization and CareTeam participant support, so duplicate prose or a source edit would not improve implementer understanding.
issue_request: FHIR-25268 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It repeated the FHIR-20907 concern that ActivityDefinition participant.type should include Organization and CareTeam and resolved to use the Participant Entity set.
initial_application: No commit explicitly tagged FHIR-25268 or J#25268 was found. The requested state appears to have been reached through the broader J#24618 participant-pattern implementation, which expanded ActivityDefinition.participant.type[x] and action-participant-type to include careteam, organization, and practitionerrole, followed by later refactors that preserved those choices.
additional_context: FHIR-20907 is the earlier same-family Published/Persuasive with Modification issue and explicitly approved adding CareTeam, Organization, and PractitionerRole. source/fhir.ini lists ActivityDefinition as an active resource, LHS Confluence minutes corroborate FHIR-25268 as the follow-up request, and Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current ActivityDefinition.participant.type already has a required action-participant-type binding whose short list includes careteam and organization, ActivityDefinition.participant.typeReference permits CareTeam and Organization, and the local action-participant-type source contains those concepts.
